# LetsEdit — Full Documentation & LLM Specification

> LetsEdit is a private, zero-cloud online PDF editor and 50+ document tools suite running client-side WebAssembly (WASM). Documents never leave the user's browser.

## 1. Executive Summary

LetsEdit is engineered to offer all capabilities found in platforms such as Adobe Acrobat, Sejda PDF, and iLovePDF, but with an architectural focus on client-side security and zero cloud data leaks. Files selected by users are decoded in browser memory using WebAssembly compilations of PDF engines (PDF.js, pdf-lib, custom WASM algorithms) and rendered onto HTML5 Canvas element stacks.

## 2. Tools & Workflows

### PDF Studio Editor (/edit_pdf)
- Direct inline text editing with matching font family, weight, and baseline detection.
- Freehand vector drawing, highlighter, eraser, and vector shapes (rectangle, ellipse, line, arrow).
- Stamp and image insertion with transparency.
- Sticky notes, annotations, and comments.
- AcroForms interactive field builder (text box, checkbox, radio button).
- Permanent cryptographic redaction (destroys text glyph streams, coordinates, and forensic artifacts).

### Organization & Splitting
- /merge_pdf: Reorder, combine, and merge multiple documents.
- /split_pdf: Extract custom page sets, odd/even pages, or split into single-page documents.
- /organize_pdf: Visual multi-page grid for rotation (90°/180°/270°), reordering, duplication, and deletion.
- /crop_pdf: Precise margin trimming and page dimension adjustment.
- /alternate_mix_pdf: Interleave duplex scanner pages from two documents into proper sequence.

### Optimization & Conversion
- /compress_pdf: Lossless and lossy vector/raster compression with live visual preview.
- /pdf_to_word: Extract structured typography, tables, and headings into editable Microsoft Word (.docx).
- /word_to_pdf: Vector PDF generation from Word (.docx) files without layout deformation.
- /pdf_to_image: Export pages to JPG or PNG with configurable DPI (72 to 300 DPI).
- /images_to_pdf: Combine multiple JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a single formatted PDF.
- /ocr_pdf: Optical Character Recognition extracting searchable text from scanned PDFs.

### Security, Cryptography & Compliance
- /sign_pdf: Legal electronic signatures complying with US ESIGN Act and EU eIDAS.
- Automatic SHA-256 legal audit certificate generation with QR code transaction verification.
- /protect_pdf: Standard AES-128 and AES-256 encryption with password protection and permissions.
- /unlock_pdf: Decrypt password-protected documents in memory.
